title.narrative: Certification, Impact & Quality Measurement for candle production unit in Vietnam

description.narrative: GWI/WOO defines itself as ‘a social enterprise that creates a premium lifestyle brand that mobilizes and connects privileged and conscious consumers with underprivileged or vulnerable communities’. GWI wants to improve and expand its existing value chain of luxury home fragrances and candles in Vietnam. The scaling of production is supported by a High Risk High Impact loan from DGGF. To develop the business GWI/WOO needs to obtain certification by global standards and set up a monitoring system for quality control and impact measurement. This will result in a commercially viable business with a sustainable traceable value chain and a communication on the impact towards the partners and consumers. The TA intervention will enhance the impact of the business. The whole value chain from sourcing to end product will comply with international standards and the impact of the business can be well measured with a monitoring system and communication to its stakeholders.
